title: Arch of Reunification
limitations: The 61.5 m sculptural arch and 30 m crown follow published dimensions, the 2021 aerial image and photographs from both road approaches.
Facial profiles, garment folds, hand poses and the subordinate relief groups are reconstructed from photos. The bronze artwork is modeled as a sculptural impression.

The historical view keeps the roads and terrain from current map data. The visible exterior represents the period before demolition in January 2024, and the supported dates end before the documented removal.
